lines_read.convention: Count distinct physical handwritten baselines, not LaTeX lines. Main column: 36, including two separate cancelled baselines (minimaux and et), headings, formula rows and the compatibility caption. Marginal notes: 28 (upper left 9; upper right 6; At 1 note 3; At 2 note 7; lower note 3). Inserted inscriptions: 6 baselines (lieux 1; replacement definition 2; At 1–At 3 1; raised ambient F-tilde 1; final avec At 1, At 2, At 3 1). Page-number inscription: 1. check_events.details: Read only scan005 packet files, its three named images, and updated packets/NOTATION.md; RULES and PREAMBLE were already read. No other page, peer output, external source or OCR read.
Personally viewed the 1684×2361 whole image once for layout: separated central list/text, five marginal blocks, corrections, connectors, displays and page overwrite.
Personally viewed the full-resolution upper half once and read every line, sign, underline, correction and marginal feature against C and H.
Personally viewed the full-resolution lower half once and read every line, Greek letter, variable case, decoration, inequality, prime and source punctuation against C and H.

Created and personally read 22 original-image crops, all at 2800 px wide with LANCZOS, autocontrast cutoff 0.4, unsharp radius 1.3/percent120/threshold3; three slanted notes rotated as recorded. All original boxes and transforms are in scan005_crop_manifest.json; exact script saved in out/scripts/scan005_crops.py.

Individually audited 13 C deletions and 4 C insertions. Recorded separate underline under cancelled éléments, uncancelled opening parenthesis before struck et, and a new raised-symbol insertion after partie.
30 C doubt marks: 10 resolved on complete local crops, 20 retained. All cancelled-text doubts retained except the single clearly readable F after élément in b′).
Every supplied source_row 119–204 classified. Long syntax stretches were checked for hidden source differences rather than rejected wholesale. H editorial notes were excluded from source text.

Compared C/G locally; inspected every complete formula with a doubt, both ends of the barred correspondence sign and upward arrow, all seven compatibility signs, all primes, ≤/≪, the straight overbar and all empty-set signs. These are visual reading events, not mathematical validation CHECK_EVENTS.

Read page overwrite; Roman I); inserted At 1–At 3; live At 4–At 7; cancelled At and possible 4; At 1/At 2 headings and Scholie references; final inserted At 1, At 2, At 3. All are included in second_boxes.
